## Valve Steamworks redistributable binaries

Ciallo distributes unmodified Steamworks SDK redistributable runtime
binaries supplied by Valve Corporation:

- `steam_api64.dll`
- `libsteam_api.so`
- `libsteam_api.dylib`

Copyright Valve Corporation. These binaries are Valve software and are not
licensed under the Facepunch MIT license above. Their use and redistribution
are governed by the Steamworks SDK Access Agreement and the applicable
Steamworks partner terms:

https://partner.steamgames.com/documentation/sdk_access_agreement

The binaries originate from `Facepunch.Steamworks/steam_api64.dll` and the
`UnityPlugin/redistributable_bin` directory in the upstream source repository.
